# Tom Select vendor files

Vendored Tom Select assets for searchable `<select>` enhancement without npm/package management or a build step.

Version: 2.6.1
License: Apache-2.0
Source files:
- https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/tom-select@2.6.1/dist/js/tom-select.complete.min.js
- https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/tom-select@2.6.1/dist/css/tom-select.default.min.css

Local files:
- `tom-select.complete.min.js`
- `tom-select.css`

When upgrading, replace both files together and update this README.
